acronyms.description: Average daily volume across a stated lookback of completed sessions. State the source and adjustment convention; a partial session is not a daily observation.
acronyms.name: ADV

acronyms.description: Best bid and offer visible to a particular venue or feed, not necessarily the national best prices.
acronyms.name: BBO

acronyms.description: Level 1 market data: top-of-book bid and ask prices and sizes, not full order-book depth.
acronyms.name: L1

acronyms.description: National Best Bid and Offer across eligible US equity venues. A single-venue quote is not an NBBO.
acronyms.name: NBBO

acronyms.description: Open, high, low, close, and volume over a bar interval. Keep interval, feed, session, and adjustment convention explicit.
acronyms.name: OHLCV

acronyms.description: Point in time: what the research process could have known at the decision cutoff, without later corrections, publications, or feature values.
acronyms.name: PIT

customAnalyses.description: Latest final minute-bar start by symbol and feed slice in the past seven days, oldest first. Symbols with no final bar in the window are absent; check the relevant session before calling a feed stale.
customAnalyses.name: Torghut: Minute-bar feed freshness by symbol
customAnalyses.sql:
SELECT provider, universe_id, feed, source_topic, market_session, delay_class, symbol, MAX(COALESCE(event_ts_exact, event_ts)) AS latest_bar_start_utc, NOW() AS checked_at_utc
FROM signal.intraday_bars_1m_v2
WHERE event_ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND event_ts < NOW() AND is_final = 1
GROUP BY provider, universe_id, feed, source_topic, market_session, delay_class, symbol
ORDER BY latest_bar_start_utc, provider, universe_id, feed, source_topic, market_session, delay_class, symbol
LIMIT 500

customAnalyses.description: Observed session dates per symbol over the last 90 calendar days in the latest finalized, as-of-eligible snapshot. Counts do not include symbols missing entirely and are not a completeness ratio; compare with the same snapshot's exchange calendar.
customAnalyses.name: Torghut: Adjusted daily bar coverage by symbol
customAnalyses.sql:
SELECT snapshot_id, symbol, COUNT(DISTINCT session_date) AS observed_sessions, MIN(session_date) AS first_observed_session, MAX(session_date) AS last_observed_session
FROM signal.adjusted_daily_bars_v2
WHERE snapshot_id = (
  SELECT snapshot_id FROM signal.snapshot_manifests_v2
  WHERE finalized_at <= NOW() AND publication_asof <= CURRENT_DATE
  ORDER BY finalized_at DESC, snapshot_id
  LIMIT 1
) AND session_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days' AND session_date <= CURRENT_DATE
GROUP BY snapshot_id, symbol
ORDER BY observed_sessions, symbol
LIMIT 500

customAnalyses.description: Up to 50 snapshots finalized in the past 90 days, with universe, feed, adjustment, calendar, publisher revision, image digest, and content fingerprints.
customAnalyses.name: Torghut: Snapshot manifest lineage
customAnalyses.sql:
SELECT snapshot_id, schema_version, universe_id, universe_symbol_hash, provider, source_feed, adjustment, calendar_version, publication_asof, first_session, last_session, symbol_count, session_count, bar_count, publisher_source_revision, publisher_image_digest, bars_content_hash, sessions_content_hash, manifest_content_hash, finalized_at
FROM signal.snapshot_manifests_v2
WHERE finalized_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' AND finalized_at <= NOW()
ORDER BY finalized_at DESC, snapshot_id
LIMIT 50

customAnalyses.description: Latest final observation per minute and feed slice in the past 24 hours, summarized by symbol. Close times volume is a turnover proxy, not executable liquidity; do not sum overlapping feed slices.
customAnalyses.name: Torghut: Recent intraday liquidity and volume by symbol
customAnalyses.sql:
WITH ranked_bars AS (
  SELECT provider, universe_id, feed, source_topic, market_session, delay_class, symbol, volume, close,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY provider, universe_id, feed, source_topic, market_session, delay_class, symbol, COALESCE(event_ts_exact, event_ts)
      ORDER BY COALESCE(ingest_ts_exact, ingest_ts) DESC, source_partition DESC, source_offset DESC
    ) AS bar_rank
  FROM signal.intraday_bars_1m_v2
  WHERE event_ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day' AND event_ts < NOW() AND is_final = 1
)
SELECT provider, universe_id, feed, source_topic, market_session, delay_class, symbol, COUNT(*) AS observed_minutes, SUM(volume) AS reported_volume, AVG(volume) AS volume_per_observed_minute, SUM(close * volume) AS close_times_volume
FROM ranked_bars
WHERE bar_rank = 1
GROUP BY provider, universe_id, feed, source_topic, market_session, delay_class, symbol
ORDER BY reported_volume DESC, provider, universe_id, feed, source_topic, market_session, delay_class, symbol
LIMIT 500

rules.description: Use event time for market ordering and ingest time for receipt or lag. In intraday_bars_1m_v2, prefer event_ts_exact and ingest_ts_exact with their millisecond counterparts as fallbacks. Compare minute starts with the relevant market session, not continuous wall-clock expectations.
rules.name: Torghut: Market time and feed freshness

rules.description: Use intraday_bars_1m_v2 and require is_final = 1 for completed-minute analytics. Preserve provider, universe, feed, source topic, session, and delay boundaries. Select one final observation per logical minute before summing volume; Kafka offsets are ordered only within a partition.
rules.name: Torghut: Final bars and feed isolation

rules.description: Use intraday_quotes_v1 for visible bid/ask spread and sizes and intraday_trades_v1 for reported prints and sizes. Use matching sources and event windows. A quote is not a trade or a fill, and overlapping feeds are not additive.
rules.name: Torghut: Quote and trade microstructure

rules.description: Use adjusted_daily_bars_v2 from one pinned snapshot_id for comparable returns. Check provider, feed, adjustment, publication_asof, and finalization against the research cutoff. Compare session_date with exchange_sessions_v1 for that snapshot, including holidays and early closes; missing rows are not zero-volume bars.
rules.name: Torghut: Adjusted bars and exchange sessions

rules.description: Use snapshot_manifests_v2 to pin the universe hash, publisher revision and image digest, calendar version, and bars, sessions, and manifest content hashes. A manifest records lineage; its presence alone does not prove coverage, performance, or qualification.
rules.name: Torghut: Snapshot provenance

rules.description: Keep crypto_market_events_v1 separate from US equity session logic. Preserve provider, location, channel, and symbol; use event_ts and ingest_ts for timing and retain topic, partition, and offset for stream provenance.
rules.name: Torghut: Crypto market event boundaries

rules.description: For causal research on intraday_features_v1, use the matching universe, feed, and symbol. Require window_end and feature availability by the decision cutoff; computed_at and archived_at distinguish computation from when the archived feature can be read.
rules.name: Torghut: Point-in-time feature inputs
